answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. Think of a signal for stability, a karst for surprise, a dune for peace — three qualities no Sybil can counterfeit in quantity.
